units.zh: 後主 劉禪
units.en: The Later Lord: Liu Shan.
units.literal: The Later Lord, Liu Shan.

units.zh: 後主諱禪，字公嗣，先主子也。
units.en: The Later Lord's taboo name was Shan, styled Gongsi; he was the Former Lord's son.
units.literal: The Later Lord's taboo name was Shan, courtesy name Gongsi; he was the Former Lord's son.

units.zh: 建安二十四年，先主為漢中王，立為王太子。
units.en: In 219 the Former Lord became king of Hanzhong and named him royal heir.
units.literal: In the twenty-fourth year of Jian'an, the Former Lord became King of Hanzhong and installed him as royal crown prince.

units.zh: 及即尊號，冊曰：「惟章武元年五月辛巳，皇帝若曰：太子禪，朕遭漢運艱難，賊臣篡盜，社稷無主，格人群正，以天明命，朕繼大統。
units.en: When he took the imperial title, the investiture edict read: "On xinsi in the fifth month of the first year of Zhangwu, the Emperor thus: Crown Prince Shan, We have endured the Han dynasty's hard straits; wicked ministers usurped the throne and the realm stood without a ruler. Surveying the worthy, by Heaven's bright mandate We succeeded to the great succession.
units.literal: When he assumed the exalted title, the investiture edict read: "On xinsi in the fifth month of the first year of Zhangwu, the Emperor thus: Crown Prince Shan, We have encountered the Han dynasty's hard straits; wicked ministers usurped and stole; the altars of soil and grain had no lord. Examining the crowd, the upright, by Heaven's bright mandate We succeeded the great succession.

units.zh: 今以禪為皇太子，以承宗廟，祗肅社稷。
units.en: We now make Shan imperial crown prince, to inherit the ancestral temples and reverently secure the altars of soil and grain.
units.literal: Now We make Shan imperial crown prince, to inherit the ancestral temples and reverently secure the altars of soil and grain.

units.zh: 使使持節丞相亮授印綬，敬聽師傅，行一物而三善皆得焉，可不勉與！」
units.en: We send the credential-bearing envoy, Chancellor Liang, to confer the seal and cord. Respectfully heed your tutors—in performing one act the three goods are all obtained; can you not exert yourself?"
units.literal: We send the envoy bearing credentials, Chancellor Liang, to confer the seal and cord. Respectfully heed your tutors—in performing one act the three goods are all obtained; can you not exert yourself?"

units.zh: 《禮記》曰：行一物而三善者，惟世子而已，其齒於學之謂也。
units.en: The Book of Rites says that performing one act and obtaining the three goods applies only to the heir apparent—it refers to his age at study.
units.literal: The Book of Rites says: In performing one act and obtaining the three goods, this applies only to the heir apparent—it means his age at study.

units.zh: 鄭玄日：物猶事也。
units.en: Zheng Xuan glosses wu as "affair."
units.literal: Zheng Xuan says: Wu means shi (affair).

units.zh: 三年夏四月，先主殂於永安宮。
units.en: In the fourth month of summer in the third year, the Former Lord died at Yongan Palace.
units.literal: In the fourth month of summer in the third year, the Former Lord died at Yongan Palace.

units.zh: 五月，後主襲位於成都，時年十七，尊皇后曰皇太后。
units.en: In the fifth month the Later Lord succeeded at Chengdu at age seventeen; the empress was honored as empress dowager.
units.literal: In the fifth month, the Later Lord succeeded to the throne at Chengdu; at the time he was seventeen, and the empress was honored as empress dowager.

units.zh: 大赦，改元。
units.en: He proclaimed a general amnesty and changed the reign title.
units.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed and the reign title was changed.

units.zh: 是歲魏黃初四年也。
units.en: That year was the fourth year of Wei's Huangchu era (223).
units.literal: That year was the fourth year of Wei's Huangchu.

units.zh: 《魏略》曰：初備在小沛，不意曹公卒至，遑遽棄家屬，後奔荊州。
units.en: The Brief Account of Wei records that Bei was at Xiaopei when Lord Cao suddenly appeared; he fled in haste, abandoning his family, and later escaped to Jing Province.
units.literal: The Brief Account of Wei states: At first Bei was at Xiaopei; he did not expect Lord Cao to arrive suddenly; in haste he abandoned his family and afterward fled to Jing Province.

units.zh: 禪時年數歲，竄匿，隨人西入漢中，為人所賣。
units.en: Shan was then only a few years old; he hid himself, followed others west into Hanzhong, and was sold into servitude.
units.literal: Shan was then several years old; he hid himself, followed others west into Hanzhong, and was sold by someone.

units.zh: 及建安十六年，關中破亂，扶風人劉括避亂入漢中，買得禪，問知其良家子，遂養為子，與娶婦，生一子。
units.en: In 211, when Guanzhong fell into chaos, Liu Kuo of Fufeng fled into Hanzhong, bought Shan, learned he came from a respectable family, raised him as his own son, gave him a wife, and Shan fathered a son.
units.literal: When in the sixteenth year of Jian'an Guanzhong was broken in disorder, Liu Kuo of Fufeng, fleeing disorder, entered Hanzhong, bought Shan, questioned and learned he was a good-family child, thereupon raised him as a son, gave him a wife, and [Shan] fathered a son.

units.zh: 初禪與備相失時，識其父字玄德。
units.en: When Shan and Bei were first separated, he already knew his father's style was Xuande.
units.literal: When Shan and Bei first lost each other, he knew his father's style was Xuande.

units.zh: 比舍人有姓簡者，及備得益州而簡為將軍，備遣簡到漢中，舍都邸。
units.en: A neighbor surnamed Jian—once Bei took Yizhou and Jian became a general, Bei sent Jian to Hanzhong, where he lodged at the commandery guesthouse.
units.literal: A neighbor surnamed Jian—when Bei obtained Yizhou and Jian became a general, Bei sent Jian to Hanzhong and lodged at the commandery residence.

units.zh: 禪乃詣簡，簡相檢訊，事皆符驗。
units.en: Shan went to Jian, who questioned him; every detail checked out.
units.literal: Shan thereupon went to Jian; Jian examined and interrogated him, and the facts all matched verification.

units.zh: 簡喜，以語張魯，魯乃洗沐送詣益州，備乃立以為太子。
units.en: Jian rejoiced and told Zhang Lu, who bathed and dressed Shan and sent him on to Yizhou; Bei then installed him as crown prince.
units.literal: Jian rejoiced and told Zhang Lu; Lu then bathed and groomed him and sent him to Yizhou, and Bei thereupon installed him as crown prince.

units.zh: 初備以諸葛亮為太子太傅，及禪立，以亮為丞相，委以諸事，謂亮曰：「政由葛氏，祭則寡人。」
units.en: At first Bei had named Zhuge Liang grand tutor of the crown prince; when Shan succeeded, he made Liang chancellor and entrusted him with all affairs, saying: "Let the Ge clan govern; I shall perform the sacrifices alone."
units.literal: At first Bei appointed Zhuge Liang Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince; when Shan was installed, he made Liang chancellor and entrusted him with all affairs, saying to Liang: "Government by the Ge clan; sacrifices by Us alone."

units.zh: 亮亦以禪未閒於政，遂總內外。
units.en: Liang too, seeing that Shan was not yet versed in government, took charge of both court and field.
units.literal: Liang also, because Shan was not yet versed in government, thereupon took charge of both inner and outer affairs.

units.zh: 臣松之案：
units.en: Pei Songzhi submits:
units.literal: Your subject Songzhi submits:

units.zh: 〈二主妃子傳〉
units.en: 〈Biographies of the Two Lords' Consorts and Sons〉
units.literal: 〈Biographies of the Two Lords' Consorts and Sons〉

units.zh: 曰“後主生於荊州”，
units.en: states "the Later Lord was born in Jing Province,"
units.literal: states "the Later Lord was born in Jing Province,"

units.zh: 〈後主傳〉
units.en: 〈Biography of the Later Lord〉
units.literal: 〈Biography of the Later Lord〉

units.zh: 云「初即帝位，年十七」，則建安十二年生也。
units.en: says "when he first took the throne, he was seventeen"—so he was born in the twelfth year of Jian'an (207).
units.literal: says "when he first assumed the imperial throne, age seventeen"—thus he was born in the twelfth year of Jian'an.

units.zh: 十三年敗於長阪，備棄妻子走，
units.en: In 208, defeated at Changban, Bei abandoned wife and children and fled,
units.literal: In the thirteenth year, defeated at Changban, Bei abandoned wife and children and fled,

units.zh: 〈趙雲傳〉
units.en: 〈Biography of Zhao Yun〉
units.literal: 〈Biography of Zhao Yun〉

units.zh: 曰「雲身抱弱子以免」，即後主也。
units.en: records that "Yun himself embraced the infant heir and escaped"—that infant was the Later Lord.
units.literal: states "Yun himself embraced the weak child and escaped"—this was the Later Lord.

units.zh: 如此，備與禪未嘗相失也。
units.en: On this showing, Bei and Shan were never truly separated.
units.literal: Thus Bei and Shan never truly lost each other.

units.zh: 又諸葛亮以禪立之明年領益州牧，其年與主簿杜微書曰「朝廷今年十八」，與禪傳相應，理當非虛。
units.en: Moreover, the year after Shan succeeded, Zhuge Liang took charge as governor of Yizhou; that year he wrote to chief clerk Du Wei that "the court is eighteen this year"—matching the Later Lord's biography, this can hardly be false.
units.literal: Moreover, the year after Shan was installed Zhuge Liang took charge as governor of Yizhou; that year in a letter to chief clerk Du Wei he wrote "the court is eighteen this year"—corresponding with the Later Lord's biography, it surely cannot be false.

units.zh: 而魚豢云備敗於小沛，禪時年始生，及奔荊州，能識其父字玄德，計當五六歲。
units.en: Yet Yu Huan says Bei was defeated at Xiaopei when Shan had just been born, and that when fleeing to Jing Province the boy could recognize his father's style Xuande—making him five or six at most.
units.literal: Yet Yu Huan says Bei was defeated at Xiaopei when Shan had just been born, and when fleeing to Jing Province could recognize his father's style Xuande—calculated, he should have been five or six.

units.zh: 備敗於小沛時，建安五年也，至禪初立，首尾二十四年，禪應過二十矣。
units.en: Bei's defeat at Xiaopei came in 200; from then until Shan's accession spans twenty-four years—Shan ought to have been past twenty.
units.literal: When Bei was defeated at Xiaopei it was the fifth year of Jian'an; from then until Shan's first installation, head to tail twenty-four years—Shan ought to have passed twenty.

units.zh: 以事相驗，理不得然。
units.en: Checked against the facts, that cannot be right.
units.literal: Testing by events, the principle cannot be so.

units.zh: 此則《魏略》之妄說，乃至二百餘言，異也！
units.en: This is the Brief Account of Wei's reckless tale, running to more than two hundred words—how strange!
units.literal: This then is the Brief Account of Wei's reckless tale, extending even to more than two hundred words—how strange!

units.zh: 又案諸書記及《諸葛亮集》，亮亦不為太子太傅。
units.en: Moreover, various records and the Collected Works of Zhuge Liang show that Liang never served as grand tutor of the crown prince.
units.literal: Moreover, examining various records and the Collected Works of Zhuge Liang, Liang also was not Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince.

units.zh: 建興元年夏，臧柯太守朱褒擁郡反。
units.en: That summer of 223, Zhu Bao, prefect of Zangke, rose in revolt and took the commandery for himself.
units.literal: In the summer of the first year of Jianxing, Zhu Bao, the Administrator of Zangke, seized the commandery and rebelled.

units.zh: 〈《魏氏春秋》曰：初，益州從事常房行部，聞褒將有異志，收其主簿案問，殺之。
units.en: 〈The Wei Annals of Spring and Autumn record that earlier, Yizhou staff officer Chang Fang, on circuit duty, heard Zhu Bao was turning disloyal; he arrested Zhu's chief clerk for questioning and had him executed.
units.literal: 〈The Wei shi chunqiu states: At first, Chang Fang, an aide in Yizhou, was making an inspection tour of his circuit; hearing that Bao was about to harbor disloyal intent, he seized Bao's chief clerk, interrogated him under investigation, and killed him.

units.zh: 褒怒，攻殺房，誣以謀反。
units.en: Zhu Bao struck back: he killed Chang Fang and then framed him for treason.
units.literal: Bao was angry; he attacked and killed Fang, and slandered him with a charge of plotting rebellion.

units.zh: 諸葛亮誅房諸子，徙其四弟於越雋，欲以安之。
units.en: Zhuge Liang put Chang Fang's sons to death, banished four of his younger brothers to Yuexi, and meant the gesture as a conciliatory signal.
units.literal: Zhuge Liang executed Fang's sons and relocated his four younger brothers to Yuexi, intending thereby to pacify the situation.

units.zh: 褒猶不悛改，遂以郡叛應雍闓。
units.en: Zhu Bao refused to mend his ways and soon threw in his lot with Yong Kai, rebelling at the head of the commandery.
units.literal: Bao still did not reform; thereupon with the commandery he rebelled in response to Yong Kai.

units.zh: 臣松之案：以為房為褒所誣，執政所宜澄察，安有妄殺不辜以悅姦慝？
units.en: Pei Songzhi argues that Chang Fang was framed by Zhu Bao and that the court should have sorted truth from falsehood instead of executing innocents to appease a traitor.
units.literal: Your subject Songzhi submits: I consider that Fang was slandered by Bao; those in power ought to have clarified and investigated—how could there be wanton killing of the guiltless in order to please the wicked?

units.zh: 斯殆妄矣！〉
units.en: That account is almost certainly wrong.〉
units.literal: This is probably false!〉

units.zh: 先是，益州郡有大姓雍闓反，流太守張裔於吳，據郡不賓，越巂夷王高定亦背叛。
units.en: Even before that, the great clan leader Yong Kai had risen in Yizhou commandery, shipped Prefect Zhang Yi off to Wu, refused allegiance while holding the territory, and Gao Ding, king of the Yuexi tribes, had joined the revolt.
units.literal: Before this, in Yizhou commandery the magnate Yong Kai rebelled, banished the Administrator Zhang Yi to Wu, held the commandery and did not submit, and the Yuexi Yi king Gao Ding also rebelled.

units.zh: 是歲，立皇后張氏。
units.en: The same year he took Lady Zhang as empress.
units.literal: That year, an empress surnamed Zhang was established.

units.zh: 遣尚書
units.en: The court dispatched a Director of the Secretariat
units.literal: A Director of the Secretariat was dispatched

units.en: The transmitted text inserts the character lang, marking him as a Gentleman of the Secretariat.
units.literal: (The text supplies the character Gentleman [lang] in the office title.)

units.zh: 鄧芝固好於吳，吳王孫權與蜀和親使聘，是歲通好。
units.en: Deng Zhi was dispatched to shore up ties with Wu; Sun Quan of Wu and Shu exchanged marriage overtures and embassies, and that year the two courts formally made peace.
units.literal: Deng Zhi to consolidate friendship with Wu; the King of Wu Sun Quan with Shu made peace by marriage and exchanged envoys; that year they opened friendly relations.

units.zh: 三年春，務農殖谷，閉關息民。
units.en: In the spring of 225 the court pushed farming and grain stores, sealed the frontier passes, and gave the realm a respite from levies and campaigns.
units.literal: In the spring of the third year, they devoted effort to agriculture and increasing grain, closed the passes, and rested the people.

units.zh: 三年春三月，丞相亮南征四郡，四郡皆平。
units.en: That March of 225 Zhuge Liang led the southern expedition; the four rebel commanderies were brought to heel.
units.literal: In the spring, third month, of the third year, Chancellor Liang campaigned south against the four commanderies; all four commanderies were pacified.

units.zh: 改益州郡為建寧郡，分建寧、永昌郡為雲南郡，又分建寧、臧柯為興古郡。
units.en: Yizhou commandery was renamed Jianning; land was carved out of Jianning and Yongchang to create Yunnan commandery, and another slice of Jianning plus Zangke became Xinggu commandery.
units.literal: Yizhou commandery was changed to Jianning commandery; Jianning and Yongchang commanderies were partitioned to form Yunnan commandery; and Jianning and Zangke were further partitioned to form Xinggu commandery.

units.zh: 十二月，亮還成都。
units.en: Zhuge Liang was back in Chengdu by the twelfth month.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, Liang returned to Chengdu.

units.zh: 四年春，都護李嚴自永安還住江州，築大城。
units.en: In the spring of 226 Li Yan left Yong'an for Jiangzhou, where he raised a major fortified city.
units.literal: In the spring of the fourth year, Chief Controller Li Yan returned from Yong'an and took up residence at Jiangzhou, and built a great city wall.

units.zh: 〈今巴郡故城是。〉
units.en: 〈The site is the old Ba commandery city wall.〉
units.literal: 〈This is the old city of Ba commandery today.〉

units.zh: 五年春，丞相亮出屯漢中，營沔北陽平石馬。
units.en: In the spring of 227 Zhuge Liang moved his headquarters to Hanzhong and threw up positions north of the Han River at Yangping and Shima.
units.literal: In the spring of the fifth year, Chancellor Liang went out and encamped at Hanzhong, and built camps north of the Mian River at Yangping and Shima.

units.zh: 〈諸葛亮集載禪三月下詔曰：「朕聞天地之道，福仁而禍淫；
units.en: 〈The collected papers of Zhuge Liang preserve an edict Liu Shan issued that March. It begins: "Heaven and earth bless the humane and punish the wanton;
units.literal: 〈The Zhuge Liang ji records that in the third month Shan issued an edict saying: "We have heard that the Way of Heaven and Earth is to bless the benevolent and bring calamity on the wanton;

units.zh: 善積者昌，惡積者喪，古今常數也。
units.en: Those who heap up goodness thrive; those who heap up evil are destroyed—that has been the rule in every age.
units.literal: Those in whom good accumulates flourish; those in whom evil accumulates perish—this is the constant pattern from ancient times to the present.

units.zh: 是以湯、武脩德而王，桀、紂極暴而亡。
units.en: Tang of Shang and King Wu won the throne by moral cultivation; Jie and Zhou lost it through brutality pushed to the limit.
units.literal: Therefore Tang and Wu cultivated virtue and became kings; Jie and Zhou reached the extreme of cruelty and perished.

units.zh: 曩者漢祚中微，網漏兇慝，董卓造難，震盪京畿。
units.en: When the Han house faltered, the law slackened and villains slipped through; Dong Zhuo's coup convulsed the capital.
units.literal: Formerly the Han mandate waned midway; the net leaked and wicked men escaped; Dong Zhuo created disaster and shook the capital region.

units.zh: 曹操階禍，竊執天衡，殘剝海內，懷無君之心。
units.en: Cao Cao climbed in on the chaos, seized the levers of state, ravaged the realm, and nursed treason against his sovereign.
units.literal: Cao Cao mounted on disaster, secretly grasped the celestial steelyard, cruelly flayed all within the seas, and harbored a heart without lord.

units.zh: 子丕孤豎，敢尋亂階，盜據神器，更姓改物，世濟其凶。
units.en: His son Cao Pi, a callow upstart, followed that rebel path, usurped the throne, changed the dynasty's name and emblems, and his line has fed on violence ever since.
units.literal: His son Pi, a solitary stripling, dared trace the steps of disorder, stole possession of the divine regalia, changed the surname and altered the tokens, and generation after generation aided his evil.

units.zh: 當此之時，皇極幽昧，天下無主，則我帝命隕越於下。
units.en: The pole star went dark; the empire had no true ruler, and the Mandate of Heaven seemed to slip from our grasp.
units.literal: At this time the supreme pivot was dark and obscure; the realm had no lord—then Our imperial mandate fell away below.

units.zh: 昭烈皇帝體明叡之德，光演文武，應乾坤之運，出身平難，經營四方，人鬼同謀，百姓與能。
units.en: Emperor Zhaolie—my father—bore brilliant, discerning virtue, gave full scope to civil and military talent, moved with heaven's turning, rose from nothing to still the turmoil, and won the allegiance of spirits and commoners alike.
units.literal: Emperor Zhaolie embodied the virtue of luminous wisdom, broadly displayed civil and martial excellence, responded to the fortune of Qian and Kun, came forth from humble station to pacify disaster, managed affairs in the four directions; men and spirits alike plotted with him, and the hundred surnames granted him their ability.

units.zh: 兆民欣戴。
units.en: The people embraced him gladly.
units.literal: The myriad people rejoiced and supported him.

units.zh: 奉順符讖，建位易號，丕承天序，補弊興衰，存复祖業，誕膺皇綱，不墜於地。
units.en: Heeding portent and prophecy, he founded our house, took a new reign title, took up heaven's succession, righted a broken age, restored our forebears' work, and caught the imperial net before it could strike the dust.
units.literal: Obeying the talismans and prophecies, he established position and changed the reign title, greatly received the sequence of Heaven, repaired what was broken and raised what was declining, preserved and restored the ancestral enterprise, broadly received the imperial net, and did not let it fall to the ground.

units.zh: 萬國未定，早世遐殂。
units.en: The realm was still unsettled when he was taken from us too soon.
units.literal: The myriad states were not yet settled when he departed early on a distant demise.

units.zh: 朕以幼衝，繼統鴻基，未習保傅之訓，而嬰祖宗之重。
units.en: I was a child when I inherited this vast charge; I had not finished the lessons tutors give a crown prince, yet I was already yoked to the weight of the ancestral shrines.
units.literal: We, being young and in the flush of youth, have succeeded to the great foundation; We have not yet studied the instruction of tutors and protectors, yet are burdened with the weight of ancestors and forebears.

units.zh: 六合壅否，社稷不建，永惟所以，念在匡救，光載前緒，未有攸濟，朕甚懼焉。
units.en: The world is choked in disorder; the altars stand insecure. I search constantly for a way to rescue the state, to brighten my father's legacy, and I have found no bridge across—this terrifies me.
units.literal: The six directions are blocked and closed; the altars of soil and grain are not established; We eternally ponder the reason, Our thought fixed on rescue and aid, to brighten and carry forward the former thread, yet there is nothing by which to cross over—We are greatly fearful.

units.zh: 是以夙興夜寐，不敢自逸，每從菲薄以益國用，勸分務穡以阜民財，授方任能以參其聽，斷私降意以養將士。
units.en: So I rise before dawn and sleep late, deny myself ease, stint the palace to swell the treasury, urge the people to farm and share surplus grain, put the able in office and listen to their counsel, and set aside private whim to feed the army.
units.literal: Therefore We rise early and retire late, not daring to indulge Ourself; We always follow austerity to increase state expenditure, encourage sharing and devote effort to agriculture to enrich the people's wealth, assign methods and employ the capable to join in Our hearing, cut off private interest and lower Our mind to nurture generals and soldiers.

units.zh: 欲奮劍長驅，指討凶逆，硃旗未舉，而丕复隕喪，斯所謂不燃我薪而自焚也。
units.en: I meant to draw the sword and march north against the usurpers, but before our crimson banners left the pass Cao Pi died—he needed no fuel from us; he burned himself out.
units.literal: We wished to brandish the sword on a long drive, point and punish the vicious rebels; the vermilion banner had not yet been raised when Pi again met with a falling demise—this is what is called not burning Our firewood yet burning oneself.

units.zh: 殘類餘醜，又支天禍，恣睢河、洛，阻兵未弭。
units.en: What is left of that brood still struts between the Yellow and Luo, propped up by fresh misfortune in Wei, and their spears have not been laid down.
units.literal: The remaining dregs of the remnant class, again propped up by Heaven's calamity, act wildly between the Yellow and Luo rivers; obstructing arms are not yet stilled.

units.zh: 諸葛丞相弘毅忠壯，忘身憂國，先帝託以天下，以勗朕躬。
units.en: Chancellor Zhuge Liang is steadfast, loyal, and bold; he sets self aside for the state. My father left the realm in his hands to brace my own weakness.
units.literal: Chancellor Zhuge is magnanimous, resolute, loyal, and stalwart; he forgets himself and worries for the state; the Former Emperor entrusted the realm to him, to encourage Our person.

units.zh: 今授之以旄鉞之重，付之以專命之權，統領步騎二十萬眾，董督元戎，龔行天罰，除患寧亂，克復舊都，在此行也。
units.en: I therefore give him the grand marshal's insignia, plenipotentiary command, two hundred thousand foot and horse under his banner, and charge him to carry out heaven's sentence: wipe out the rebels, still the chaos, and win back the old capital—this expedition must do it.
units.literal: Now We confer on him the weight of yak-tail pennant and battle-axe, entrust to him the authority of sole command, to command foot and horse in two hundred thousand, supervise and direct the great hosts, reverently execute Heaven's punishment, remove calamity and quiet disorder, conquer and recover the old capital—it lies in this campaign.

units.zh: 昔項籍總一強眾，跨州兼土，所務者大，然卒敗垓下，死於東城，宗族如焚，為笑千載，皆不以義，陵上虐下故也。
units.en: Xiang Yu once commanded a mighty host and held half the empire, yet he fell at Gaixia, died at Dongcheng, and his clan went up like kindling—a jest for every age—because he trampled right order and tyrannized those below him.
units.literal: Formerly Xiang Yu gathered one strong host, spanned provinces and combined lands; what he pursued was great, yet in the end he was defeated at Gaixia, died at Dongcheng, his kin and clan like being burned, a laughingstock for a thousand ages—all because he did not use righteousness, overbore superiors and cruelly abused inferiors.

units.zh: 今賊效尤，天人所怨，奉時宜速，庶憑炎精祖宗威靈相助之福，所向必克。
units.en: Today's rebels copy that folly; heaven and the people alike curse them. The moment calls for speed. With the fiery virtue of Han and the spirits of our forebears at our back, every blow must tell.
units.literal: Now the rebels imitate his excess; Heaven and men alike resent them; to seize the season one ought to be swift; perhaps relying on the blessing of the fiery essence's ancestors' awesome spirits assisting, wherever one turns one will surely conquer.

units.zh: 吳王孫權同卹災患，潛軍合謀，掎角其後。
units.en: King Sun Quan of Wu shares our grief at this evil; his troops stand ready in secret, and we will pinch the enemy from two sides.
units.literal: The King of Wu Sun Quan together pities disaster and calamity; hidden armies join in plotting, pincering from their rear.

units.zh: 涼州諸國王各遣月支、康居胡侯支富、康植等二十餘人詣受節度，大軍北出，便欲率將兵馬，奮戈先驅。
units.en: Kings of the Liangzhou frontier have sent over twenty nobles—Yuezhi and Sogdian lords among them—to take orders from us; when our host marches north they will spur ahead at the van with lance and shield.
units.literal: The various kings of Liangzhou each sent more than twenty persons such as the Yuezhi and Kangju Hu marquises Zhi Fu and Kang Zhi to come receive regulation and control; when the great army goes north, they then wish to lead and command horse and foot, brandishing halberds as vanguard.

units.zh: 天命既集，人事又至，師貞勢並，必無敵矣。
units.en: Heaven's mandate is gathering; the human moment has come; our cause is just and our strength massed—no one can stand against us.
units.literal: Heaven's mandate is already assembled; human affairs moreover have arrived; the army is correct and power joins together—there will surely be none who can oppose.

units.zh: 夫王者之兵，有徵無戰，尊而且義，莫敢抗也，故鳴條之役，軍不血刃，牧野之師，商人倒戈。
units.en: A true king's host goes forth to chastise, not to brawl; it is august and in the right, so none dare face it—at Mingtiao no blade was wet; at Muye the Shang warriors dropped their weapons of their own accord.
units.literal: As for the army of a king, there is expedition but no battle; it is honored and moreover righteous—none dare resist; therefore at the campaign of Mingtiao the army did not bloody blades; at the host of Muye the merchants turned their spears.

units.zh: 今旍麾首路，其所經至，亦不欲窮兵極武。
units.en: Where our standards lead, I have no wish to wage war to the last extremity.
units.literal: Now as the banners and standards take the road first, where they pass through, We also do not wish to exhaust arms to the utmost of military force.

units.zh: 有能棄邪從正，簞食壺漿以迎王師者，國有常典，封寵大小，各有品限。
units.en: Those who leave wrong for right and meet our army with food and drink will find rank and fief spelled out in the statutes, great or small according to merit.
units.literal: If there are those able to cast aside evil and follow the correct, with basket of food and pot of broth to welcome the royal army, the state has constant statutes; enfeoffment and favor, great and small, each have grade and limit.

units.zh: 及魏之宗族、支葉、中外，有能規利害、審逆順之數，來詣降者，皆原除之。
units.en: Any member of the Cao clan, near kin or distant, who reads the tide of fortune and comes over to us will be pardoned outright.
units.literal: As for Wei's kin and clan, branch and leaf, inner and outer, if there are those able to gauge benefit and harm, examine the reckoning of rebellion and submission, and come to surrender, all will be pardoned and excused.

units.zh: 昔輔果絕親於智氏，而蒙全宗之福，微子去殷，項伯歸漢，皆受茅土之慶。
units.en: Fu Guo broke with the Zhi and saved his whole line; Weizi left Shang; Xiang Bo went over to Han—all were enfeoffed with land.
units.literal: Formerly Fu Guo severed kinship with the Zhi clan and received the blessing of preserving the whole lineage; Weizi left Yin; Xiang Bo returned to Han—all received the felicity of enfeoffment with bundles of thatch.

units.zh: 此前世之明驗也。
units.en: History has already written the lesson in plain characters.
units.literal: These are clear proofs of former ages.

units.zh: 若其迷沈不反，將助亂人，不式王命，戮及妻孥，罔有攸赦。
units.en: Whoever clings to delusion, abets the rebels, and defies this decree will die with wife and children—there will be no mercy.
units.literal: If they sink in delusion and do not return, will assist disorderly men, do not model themselves on the king's command, slaughter will extend to wives and children, and there will be none who are pardoned.

units.zh: 廣宣恩威，貸其元帥，吊其殘民。
units.en: Spread both kindness and terror: spare their generals where you can, and pity the common folk caught in the middle.
units.literal: Broadly proclaim grace and might; spare their commander-in-chief; comfort their remnant people.

units.zh: 他如詔書律令，丞相其露布天下，使稱朕意焉。」〉
units.en: All other details follow statute and edict: let the Chancellor publish this abroad until every corner of the realm knows my mind."〉"
units.literal: As for the rest according to edicts, statutes, and ordinances, let the Chancellor publish them to all under Heaven, causing them to accord with Our intent."〉"

units.zh: 六年春，亮出攻祁山，不克。
units.en: In the spring of 228 Zhuge Liang struck at Qishan but failed to take it.
units.literal: In the spring of the sixth year, Liang went out and attacked Qishan; he did not overcome.

units.zh: 冬，復出散關，圍陳倉，糧盡退。
units.en: That winter he came out through Sanguan again, laid siege to Chencang, and pulled back when his grain ran out.
units.literal: In winter, he again went out at Sanguan, besieged Chencang, and when provisions were exhausted withdrew.

units.zh: 魏將王雙率軍追亮，亮與戰，破之，斬雙，還漢中。
units.en: The Wei commander Wang Shuang gave chase; Zhuge Liang turned on him, broke his force, killed Wang Shuang, and withdrew to Hanzhong.
units.literal: Wei general Wang Shuang led an army in pursuit of Liang; Liang fought with him, defeated him, beheaded Shuang, and returned to Hanzhong.

units.zh: 七年春，亮遣陳式攻武都、陰平，遂克定二郡。
units.en: In the spring of 229 Zhuge Liang sent Chen Shi against Wudu and Yinping; both commanderies fell.
units.literal: In the spring of the seventh year, Liang dispatched Chen Shi to attack Wudu and Yinping; thereupon he conquered and settled the two commanderies.

units.zh: 冬，亮徙從府營於南山下原上，築漢、樂二城。
units.en: That winter he shifted his headquarters camp onto the plateau south of the Qinling crest and raised the twin fortresses of Hanzhong city and Lecheng.
units.literal: In winter, Liang moved the attendant office camp to the high plain south of the mountains and built the two cities of Han and Le.

units.zh: 是歲，孫權稱帝，與蜀約盟，共交分天下。
units.en: The same year Sun Quan took the imperial title; he and Shu renewed their treaty and formally split their spheres in the Chinese world.
units.literal: That year, Sun Quan declared himself emperor, covenanted alliance with Shu, and together they exchanged division of the realm under Heaven.

units.zh: 八年秋，魏使司馬懿由西城，張郺由子午，曹真由斜谷，
units.en: In the autumn of 230 Wei launched a three-pronged move on Hanzhong: Sima Yi through Xicheng, Zhang He through the Ziwu defile, and Cao Zhen up the Xie Valley,
units.literal: In the autumn of the eighth year, Wei sent Sima Yi by Xicheng, Zhang He by Ziwu, and Cao Zhen by Xie Valley,

units.zh: 〈斜，余奢反。〉
units.en: 〈Commentary gloss: the graph xie is read with the yu-she fanqie.〉
units.literal: 〈Xie: read with the fanqie initial yu and final she.〉

units.zh: 欲攻漢中。
units.en: intending to overrun Hanzhong.
units.literal: intending to attack Hanzhong.

units.zh: 丞相亮待之於城固、赤坂，大雨道絕，真等皆還。
units.en: Zhuge Liang blocked them at Chenggu and Chipo; torrential rains washed out the roads, and Cao Zhen's columns had to turn back.
units.literal: Chancellor Liang awaited them at Chenggu and Chipo; great rain cut off the roads, and Zhen and the others all returned.

units.zh: 是歲，魏延破魏雍州剌史郭淮於陽溪。
units.en: The same year Wei Yan routed Yongzhou inspector Guo Huai for Wei at Yangxi.
units.literal: That year, Wei Yan defeated Wei's Inspector of Yongzhou Guo Huai at Yangxi.

units.zh: 徙魯王永為甘陵王，梁王理為安平王，皆以魯、梁在吳分界故也。
units.en: Prince Yong of Lu was redesignated prince of Ganling and Prince Li of Liang became prince of Pingan, since Lu and Liang lay in territory allotted to Wu.
units.literal: The Prince of Lu Yong was moved to be Prince of Ganling, and the Prince of Liang Li was moved to be Prince of Pingan—both because Lu and Liang lay on Wu's side of the partition.

units.zh: 九年春二月，亮復出軍圍祁山，始以木牛運。
units.en: In the second month of 231 Zhuge Liang marched on Qishan again, this time supplying the army with his wooden-ox carts.
units.literal: In the spring, second month, of the ninth year, Liang again went out with the army and besieged Qishan, for the first time using the wooden ox to transport.

units.zh: 魏司馬懿、張郺救祁山。
units.en: Sima Yi and Zhang He of Wei raced to lift the siege at Qishan.
units.literal: Wei's Sima Yi and Zhang He relieved Qishan.

units.zh: 夏六月，亮糧盡退軍，郺追至青封，與亮交戰，被箭死。
units.en: By the sixth month Zhuge Liang had exhausted his grain and fell back; Zhang He pressed him to Qingfeng, joined battle, and was killed by an arrow.
units.literal: In the summer, sixth month, when Liang's provisions were exhausted he withdrew the army; He pursued to Qingfeng, fought with Liang, and was hit by an arrow and died.

units.zh: 秋八月，都護李嚴廢徙梓潼郡。
units.en: That August Li Yan was stripped of office and exiled to Zitong.
units.literal: In the autumn, eighth month, Chief Controller Li Yan was dismissed and banished to Zitong commandery.

units.zh: 〈《漢晉春秋》曰：冬十月，江陽至江州有鳥從江南飛渡江北，不能達，墮水死者以千數。〉
units.en: 〈The Han–Jin Annals of Spring and Autumn record that in the tenth month flocks tried to fly from the south bank of the Yangzi toward Jiangzhou; thousands dropped into the river and drowned.〉
units.literal: 〈The Han Jin chunqiu states: In the winter, tenth month, from Jiangyang to Jiangzhou there were birds flying from south of the Yangzi to cross north of the Yangzi; unable to reach, they fell into the water and died by the thousands.〉

units.zh: 十年，亮休士勸農於黃沙，作流馬木牛畢，教兵講武。
units.en: In 232 Zhuge Liang rested his troops and promoted farming at Huangsha, finished building his 'flowing horse' supply carts to complement the wooden oxen, and put the army through maneuvers.
units.literal: In the tenth year, Liang rested the soldiers and encouraged agriculture at Huangsha; when the flowing horse and wooden ox were completed, he drilled the troops and lectured on martial affairs.

units.zh: 十一年冬，亮使諸軍運米，集於斜谷口，治斜谷邸閣。
units.en: In the winter of 233 he had every column haul grain to the mouth of the Xie Valley and built granaries and relay stations there.
units.literal: In the winter of the eleventh year, Liang ordered the various armies to transport grain, assemble at the mouth of Xie Valley, and construct the Xie Valley depot lodges.

units.zh: 是歲，南夷劉冑反，將軍馬忠破平之。
units.en: The same year the southern chieftain Liu Zhou rose; Ma Zhong crushed the revolt.
units.literal: That year, the southern Yi Liu Zhou rebelled; General Ma Zhong defeated and pacified him.

units.zh: 十二年春二月，亮由斜谷出，始以流馬運。
units.en: In the second month of 234 Zhuge Liang debouched from the Xie Valley, this time using the flowing-horse carts for logistics.
units.literal: In the spring, second month, of the twelfth year, Liang came out by Xie Valley, for the first time using the flowing horse to transport.

units.zh: 秋八月，亮卒渭濱。
units.en: He died that eighth month by the Wei River in the field.
units.literal: In the autumn, eighth month, Liang died on the bank of the Wei River.

units.zh: 征西大將軍魏延與丞相長史楊儀爭權不和，舉兵相攻，延敗走。
units.en: Wei Yan, general who conquers the west, and Yang Yi, chief clerk of the chancellery, fell out over authority, drew swords on each other, and Wei Yan broke and ran.
units.literal: General Who Conquers the West Wei Yan and the Chancellor's chief clerk Yang Yi, contending for power and not harmonious, raised arms and attacked each other; Yan was defeated and fled.

units.zh: 斬延首，儀率諸軍還成都。
units.en: Wei Yan was beheaded; Yang Yi brought the armies back to Chengdu.
units.literal: They beheaded Yan's head; Yi led the various armies back to Chengdu.

units.zh: 大赦。
units.en: A general amnesty was declared.
units.literal: A great amnesty was proclaimed.

units.zh: 以左將軍吳壹為車騎將軍，假節督漢中。
units.en: Wu Yi, general of the left, was promoted to general of chariots and cavalry, given the imperial baton, and put in charge of Hanzhong.
units.literal: The General of the Left Wu Yi was made General of Chariots and Cavalry, given credentials of authority, and directed Hanzhong.

units.zh: 以丞相留府長史蔣琬為尚書令，總統國事。
units.en: Jiang Wan, chief clerk of Zhuge Liang's rear office, became director of the secretariat and took overall direction of government.
units.literal: The Chancellor's chief clerk of the rear headquarters Jiang Wan was made Director of the Secretariat, overall presiding state affairs.

units.zh: 十三年春正月，中軍師楊儀廢徙漢嘉郡。
units.en: In the first month of 235 Yang Yi was stripped of rank and banished to Hanjia.
units.literal: In the spring, first month, of the thirteenth year, Army Supervisor Yang Yi was dismissed and banished to Hanjia commandery.

units.zh: 夏四月，進蔣琬位為大將軍。
units.en: That April Jiang Wan was promoted to grand general.
units.literal: In the summer, fourth month, Jiang Wan's position was advanced to Grand General.

units.zh: 十四年夏四月，後主至湔，
units.en: In the fourth month of 236 the Later Lord traveled to Jian,
units.literal: In the summer, fourth month, of the fourteenth year, the Later Lord arrived at Jian,

units.zh: 〈臣松之案：湔，縣名也，屬蜀郡，音翦。〉
units.en: 〈Pei Songzhi notes that Jian is a county in Shu commandery, read like jian (scissors).〉
units.literal: 〈Your subject Songzhi submits: Jian is the name of a county, belonging to Shu commandery, pronounced jian.〉

units.zh: 登觀坂，看汶水之流，旬日還成都。
units.en: climbed Observation Hill to watch the Min River, stayed about ten days, and returned to Chengdu.
units.literal: ascended Observation Slope, viewed the flow of the Wen River, and after ten days returned to Chengdu.

units.zh: 徙武都氐王苻健及氐民四百餘戶於成都。
units.en: More than four hundred Di households under their king Fu Jian were resettled from Wudu into Chengdu.
units.literal: The Di king of Wudu Fu Jian and more than four hundred Di households were relocated to Chengdu.

units.zh: 十五年夏六月，皇后張氏薨。
units.en: Empress Zhang died in the sixth month of 237.
units.literal: In the summer, sixth month, of the fifteenth year, Empress Zhang died.

units.zh: 延熙元年春正月，立皇后張氏。
units.en: In the first month of 238 he took another Lady Zhang as empress.
units.literal: In the spring, first month, of the first year of Yanxi, an empress surnamed Zhang was established.

units.zh: 大赦，攻元。
units.en: He proclaimed a general amnesty and changed the era name to Yanxi.
units.literal: A great amnesty was proclaimed, and the reign title was changed.

units.zh: 立子睿為太子，子瑤為安定王。
units.en: He named his son Liu Rui crown prince and enfeoffed Liu Yao as prince of Anding.
units.literal: His son Rui was established as heir apparent, and his son Yao was established as Prince of Anding.

units.zh: 冬十一月，大將軍蔣琬出屯漢中。
units.en: That November Grand General Jiang Wan moved his headquarters to Hanzhong.
units.literal: In the winter, eleventh month, Grand General Jiang Wan went out and encamped at Hanzhong.

units.zh: 二年春三月，進蔣琬位為大司馬。
units.en: In the third month of 239 Jiang Wan was promoted to grand marshal.
units.literal: In the spring, third month, of the second year, Jiang Wan's position was advanced to Grand Marshal.

units.zh: 三年春，使越巂太守張嶷平定越巂郡。
units.en: In the spring of 240 he sent Zhang Ni, prefect of Yuexi, to bring the commandery fully under control.
units.literal: In the spring of the third year, he ordered the Administrator of Yuexi Zhang Ni to pacify and settle Yuexi commandery.

units.zh: 四年冬十月，尚書令費禕至漢中，與蔣琬咨論事計，歲盡還。
units.en: In the tenth month of 241 Fei Yi went to Hanzhong to confer with Jiang Wan on policy and was back before the year closed.
units.literal: In the winter, tenth month, of the fourth year, Director of the Secretariat Fei Yi arrived at Hanzhong, consulted with Jiang Wan on affairs and plans, and at year's end returned.

units.zh: 五年春正月，監軍姜維督偏軍，自漢中還屯涪縣。
units.en: In the first month of 242 Jiang Wei, as army supervisor, led a detached column from Hanzhong down to garrison Fu.
units.literal: In the spring, first month, of the fifth year, Army Supervisor Jiang Wei supervised detached forces, from Hanzhong returned to encamp at Fu county.

units.zh: 六年冬十月，大司馬蔣琬自還漢中，住涪。
units.en: In the tenth month of 243 Grand Marshal Jiang Wan left Hanzhong and established himself at Fu.
units.literal: In the winter, tenth month, of the sixth year, Grand Marshal Jiang Wan himself returned from Hanzhong and took up residence at Fu.

units.zh: 十一月，大赦。
units.en: November brought another general amnesty.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, a great amnesty was proclaimed.

units.zh: 以尚書令費禕為大將軍。
units.en: Fei Yi was promoted from director of the secretariat to grand general.
units.literal: The Director of the Secretariat Fei Yi was made Grand General.

units.zh: 七年閏月，魏大將軍曹爽、夏侯玄等向漢中，鎮北大將軍王平拒興勢圍，大將軍費禕督諸軍往赴救，魏軍退。
units.en: In the intercalary month of 244 Cao Shuang and Xiahou Xuan of Wei drove on Hanzhong; Wang Ping, general who guards the north, held the Xingshi rampart; Grand General Fei Yi led the relief host; the Wei forces withdrew.
units.literal: In the intercalary month of the seventh year, Wei's Grand General Cao Shuang, Xuan of the Xiahou, and others advanced on Hanzhong; General Who Guards the North Wang Ping resisted at the Xingshi enclosure; Grand General Fei Yi supervised the various armies to go hasten relief, and the Wei army withdrew.

units.zh: 夏四月，安平王理卒。
units.en: Prince Li of Pingan died that fourth month.
units.literal: In the summer, fourth month, the Prince of Pingan Li died.

units.zh: 秋九月，禕還成都。
units.en: Fei Yi was back in Chengdu by the ninth month.
units.literal: In the autumn, ninth month, Yi returned to Chengdu.

units.zh: 八年秋八月，皇太后薨。
units.en: The eighth month of 245 brought news that the empress dowager had died.
units.literal: In the autumn, eighth month, of the eighth year, the Empress Dowager died.

units.zh: 十二月，大將軍費禕至漢中，行圍守。
units.en: That December Fei Yi reached Hanzhong to oversee the ring of frontier garrisons.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, Grand General Fei Yi arrived at Hanzhong and carried out encirclement defense.

units.zh: 九年夏六月，費禕還成都。
units.en: Fei Yi was back in Chengdu by the sixth month of 246.
units.literal: In the summer, sixth month, of the ninth year, Fei Yi returned to Chengdu.

units.zh: 秋，大赦。
units.en: Autumn brought a general amnesty.
units.literal: In autumn, a great amnesty was proclaimed.

units.zh: 冬十一月，大司馬蔣琬卒。
units.en: Grand Marshal Jiang Wan died that November.
units.literal: In the winter, eleventh month, Grand Marshal Jiang Wan died.

units.zh: 〈《魏略》曰：琬卒，禪乃自攝國事。〉
units.en: 〈The Wei Summary says that when Jiang Wan died, Liu Shan personally assumed direction of government.〉
units.literal: 〈The Wei lüe states: When Wan died, Shan thereupon himself took in hand state affairs.〉

units.zh: 十年，涼州胡王白虎文、治無戴等率眾降，衛將軍姜維迎逆安撫，居之於繁縣。
units.en: In 247 the Qiang chieftains Bai Huwen and Zhi Wudai of Liangzhou brought their followers in; Jiang Wei, guard general, received them kindly and resettled the people at Fan.
units.literal: In the tenth year, the Liangzhou Hu kings Bai Huwen, Zhi Wudai, and others led their masses in surrender; Guard General Jiang Wei went to welcome them, pacified them, and settled them at Fan county.

units.zh: 是歲，汶山平康夷反，維往討，破平之。
units.en: The same year the Pingkang tribesmen of Wenshan rose; Jiang Wei marched against them and crushed the revolt.
units.literal: That year, the Pingkang Yi of Wenshan rebelled; Wei went to punish them, defeated and pacified them.

units.zh: 十一年夏五月，大將軍費禕出屯漢中。
units.en: In the fifth month of 248 Grand General Fei Yi moved his headquarters to Hanzhong.
units.literal: In the summer, fifth month, of the eleventh year, Grand General Fei Yi went out and encamped at Hanzhong.

units.zh: 秋，涪陵屬國民夷反，車騎將軍鄧芝往討，皆破平之。
units.en: That autumn the mixed Chinese and tribal population of the Fuling dependency revolted; Deng Zhi, general of chariots and cavalry, led the punitive force and stamped it out.
units.literal: In autumn, the people and Yi of Fuling dependent state rebelled; General of Chariots and Cavalry Deng Zhi went to punish them, and all were defeated and pacified.

units.zh: 十二年春正月，魏誅大將軍曹爽等，右將軍夏侯霸來降。
units.en: In the first month of 249 Wei put Cao Shuang and his faction to death; Xiahou Ba, general of the right, crossed over to Shu.
units.literal: In the spring, first month, of the twelfth year, Wei executed Grand General Cao Shuang and others; General of the Right Xiahou Ba came to surrender.

units.zh: 夏四月，大赦。
units.en: A general amnesty was declared that fourth month.
units.literal: In the summer, fourth month, a great amnesty was proclaimed.

units.zh: 秋，衛將軍姜維出攻雍州，不克而還。
units.en: That autumn Jiang Wei struck into Yongzhou but could not break the Wei lines and withdrew.
units.literal: In autumn, Guard General Jiang Wei went out and attacked Yongzhou; he did not overcome and returned.

units.zh: 將軍句安、李韶降魏。
units.en: The generals Gou An and Li Shao went over to Wei.
units.literal: Generals Gou An and Li Shao surrendered to Wei.

units.zh: 十三年，姜維復出西平，不克而還。
units.en: In 250 Jiang Wei marched on Xiping again without success.
units.literal: In the thirteenth year, Jiang Wei again went out to Xiping; he did not overcome and returned.

units.zh: 十四年夏，大將軍費禕還成都。
units.en: Grand General Fei Yi came home to Chengdu that summer of 251.
units.literal: In the summer of the fourteenth year, Grand General Fei Yi returned to Chengdu.

units.zh: 冬，復北駐漢壽。
units.en: That winter he moved his headquarters north again to Hanshou.
units.literal: In winter, he again encamped north at Hanshou.

units.zh: 大赦。
units.en: Another general amnesty was issued.
units.literal: A great amnesty was proclaimed.

units.zh: 十五年，吳王孫權薨。
units.en: Sun Quan of Wu died in 252.
units.literal: In the fifteenth year, the King of Wu Sun Quan died.

units.zh: 立子琮為西河王。
units.en: He enfeoffed his son Liu Cong as prince of Xihe.
units.literal: His son Cong was established as Prince of Xihe.

units.zh: 十六年春正月，大將軍費禕為魏降人郭?所殺於漢壽。
units.en: In the first month of 253 Grand General Fei Yi was assassinated at Hanshou by Guo Xun, a Wei defector.
units.literal: In the spring, first month, of the sixteenth year, Grand General Fei Yi was killed at Hanshou by Guo ? of Wei who had surrendered.

units.zh: 夏四月，衛將軍姜維復率眾圍南安，不克而還。
units.en: That April Jiang Wei besieged Nan'an again but could not take it.
units.literal: In the summer, fourth month, Guard General Jiang Wei again led the host to besiege Nan'an; he did not overcome and returned.

units.zh: 十七年春正月，姜維還成都。
units.en: Jiang Wei was in Chengdu by the first month of 254.
units.literal: In the spring, first month, of the seventeenth year, Jiang Wei returned to Chengdu.

units.zh: 大赦。
units.en: The court proclaimed a general amnesty.
units.literal: A great amnesty was proclaimed.

units.zh: 夏六月，維復率眾出隴西。
units.en: That June Jiang Wei drove another campaign into Longxi.
units.literal: In the summer, sixth month, Wei again led the host out into Longxi.

units.zh: 冬，拔狄道、
units.en: That winter he seized Didao,
units.literal: In winter, he took Didao,

units.zh: （河間）
units.en: The transmitted text adds the gloss Hejian for the place name.
units.literal: (Hejian)

units.zh: [河關]、臨洮三縣民，居於綿竹、繁縣。
units.en: He took the people of Didao, [Heguan], and Lintao—three counties in all—and resettled them at Mianzhu and Fan.
units.literal: [Heguan], and the people of the three counties of Lintao, were settled at Mianzhu and Fan counties.

units.zh: 十八年春，姜維還成都。
units.en: In the spring of 255 Jiang Wei returned to Chengdu.
units.literal: In the spring of the eighteenth year, Jiang Wei returned to Chengdu.

units.zh: 夏，復率諸軍出狄道，與魏雍州剌史王經戰於洮西，大破之。
units.en: That summer he marched on Didao again, met Wang Jing, Yongzhou inspector for Wei, west of the Tao River, and shattered his army.
units.literal: In summer, he again led the various armies out from Didao, fought with Wei's Inspector of Yongzhou Wang Jing west of the Tao, and greatly defeated him.

units.zh: 經退保狄道城，維卻住鍾題。
units.en: Wang Jing fell back into Didao; Jiang Wei halted his advance at Zhongti.
units.literal: Jing withdrew to defend Didao city; Wei halted and encamped at Zhongti.

units.zh: 十九年春，進姜維位為大將軍，督戎馬，與鎮西將軍胡濟期會上邽，濟失誓不至。
units.en: In the spring of 256 Jiang Wei was promoted to grand general and took command of the field armies; he and Hu Ji, general who guards the west, had agreed to meet at Shanggui, but Hu Ji never came.
units.literal: In the spring of the nineteenth year, Jiang Wei's position was advanced to Grand General; he supervised military horses; with General Who Guards the West Hu Ji he made a rendezvous at Shanggui, but Ji failed the oath and did not arrive.

units.zh: 秋八月，維為魏大將軍鄧艾所破於上邽。
units.en: That eighth month Deng Ai, grand general of Wei, defeated him at Shanggui.
units.literal: In the autumn, eighth month, Jiang Wei was by Wei's Grand General Deng Ai defeated at Shanggui.

units.zh: 維退軍還成都。
units.en: Jiang Wei pulled the army back to Chengdu.
units.literal: Wei withdrew the army and returned to Chengdu.

units.zh: 是歲，立子瓚為新平王。
units.en: The same year he made his son Liu Zan prince of Xinping.
units.literal: That year, his son Zan was established as Prince of Xinping.

units.zh: 大赦。
units.en: A general amnesty followed.
units.literal: A great amnesty was proclaimed.

units.zh: 二十年，聞魏大將軍諸葛誕據壽春以叛，姜維復率眾出駱谷，至芒水。
units.en: In 257, when word came that Zhuge Dan of Wei had risen at Shouchun, Jiang Wei drove through the Lu Valley again and reached Mangshui.
units.literal: In the twentieth year, hearing that Wei's Grand General Zhuge Dan had occupied Shouchun in rebellion, Jiang Wei again led the host out through Lu Valley as far as Mangshui.

units.zh: 是歲大赦。
units.en: The year closed with a general amnesty.
units.literal: That year a great amnesty was proclaimed.

units.zh: 景耀元年，姜維還成都。
units.en: In 258 Jiang Wei was back in Chengdu.
units.literal: In the first year of Jingyao, Jiang Wei returned to Chengdu.

units.zh: 史官言景星見，於是大赦，改年。
units.en: Court astronomers reported an auspicious jing star; the throne ordered a general amnesty and adopted the reign title Jingyao.
units.literal: The scribes reported that a jing star appeared; thereupon a great amnesty was proclaimed and the year was changed.

units.zh: 宦人黃皓始專政。
units.en: The eunuch Huang Hao began to dominate the court.
units.literal: The eunuch Huang Hao for the first time monopolized government.

units.zh: 吳大將軍孫琳廢其主亮，立琅邪王休。
units.en: In Wu, Grand General Sun Lin deposed Sun Liang and set Sun Xiu, prince of Langye, on the throne.
units.literal: Wu Grand General Sun Lin deposed his ruler Liang and established the Prince of Langye Xiu.

units.zh: 二年夏六月，立子諶為北地王，恂為新興王，虔為上黨王。
units.en: In the sixth month of 259 he enfeoffed Liu Chen as prince of Beidi, Liu Xun as prince of Xinxing, and Liu Qian as prince of Shangdang.
units.literal: In the summer, sixth month, of the second year, his son Chen was established as Prince of Beidi, Xun as Prince of Xinxing, and Qian as Prince of Shangdang.

units.zh: 三年秋九月，追諡故將軍關羽、張飛、馬超、龐統、黃忠。
units.en: That ninth month of 260 posthumous honors were conferred on Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, Ma Chao, Pang Tong, and Huang Zhong.
units.literal: In the autumn, ninth month, of the third year, posthumous titles were granted to the former generals Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, Ma Chao, Pang Tong, and Huang Zhong.

units.zh: 四年春三月，追諡故將軍趙雲。
units.en: In the third month of 261 Zhao Yun received a posthumous canonization.
units.literal: In the spring, third month, of the fourth year, a posthumous title was granted to the former general Zhao Yun.

units.zh: 冬十月，大赦。
units.en: October brought another general amnesty.
units.literal: In the winter, tenth month, a great amnesty was proclaimed.

units.zh: 五年春正月，西河王琮卒。
units.en: Prince Liu Cong of Xihe died in the first month of 263.
units.literal: In the spring, first month, of the fifth year, the Prince of Xihe Cong died.

units.zh: 是歲，姜維復率眾出侯和，為鄧艾所破，還住沓中。
units.en: The same year Jiang Wei tried another sortie at Hehe; Deng Ai broke him, and he fell back to garrison Tazhong.
units.literal: That year, Jiang Wei again led the host out at Hehe, was by Deng Ai defeated, and returned to encamp at Tazhong.

units.zh: 六年夏，魏大興徒從眾，命征西將軍鄧艾、鎮西將軍鍾會、雍州剌史諸葛緒數道並攻。
units.en: That summer of 263 Wei mobilized a huge host and ordered Deng Ai, Zhong Hui, and Yongzhou inspector Zhuge Xu to advance on several columns.
units.literal: In the summer of the sixth year, Wei on a great scale raised transport-follower masses, ordering General Who Conquers the West Deng Ai, General Who Guards the West Zhong Hui, and Inspector of Yongzhou Zhuge Xu on several routes jointly to attack.

units.zh: 於是遣左右車騎將軍張翼、廖化、輔國大將軍董厥等拒之。
units.en: Shu sent Zhang Yi and Liao Hua, generals of chariots and cavalry left and right, and Dong Jue, assistant grand general for state support, to hold the line.
units.literal: Thereupon he dispatched the Left and Right Generals of Chariots and Cavalry Zhang Yi, Liao Hua, Assistant State General Dong Jue, and others to resist them.

units.zh: 大赦。
units.en: A general amnesty was declared.
units.literal: A great amnesty was proclaimed.

units.zh: 改元為炎興。
units.en: The era name was changed to Yanxing.
units.literal: The reign title was changed to Yanxing.

units.zh: 冬，鄧艾破衛將軍諸葛瞻於綿竹。
units.en: That winter Deng Ai shattered Zhuge Zhan, guard general, at Mianzhu.
units.literal: In winter, Deng Ai defeated Guard General Zhuge Zhan at Mianzhu.

units.zh: 用光祿大夫譙周策，降於艾，奉書曰：
units.en: On the advice of Qiao Zhou, grandee of the imperial household, he capitulated to Deng Ai and sent this letter:
units.literal: Employing the plan of Imperial Household Grandee Qiao Zhou, he surrendered to Ai and presented a letter saying:

units.zh: 限分江、漢，遇值深遠，階緣蜀土，斗絕一隅，干運犯冒，漸苒歷載，遂與京畿攸隔萬里。
units.en: The Yangzi and Han have long cut us off from the heartland; fate set us on this remote plateau of Shu, a pocket realm hemmed by mountains. Year after year we have pressed our luck, until we stand ten thousand li from the imperial precincts.
units.literal: Limited and partitioned by the Yangzi and Han, encountering circumstances deep and remote, ascending by steps onto Shu soil, isolated in a single corner, interfering with fortune and offending risk, gradually dragging through years, thereupon with the capital region was separated by ten thousand li.

units.zh: 每惟黃初中，文皇帝命虎牙將軍鮮于輔，宣溫密之詔，申三好之恩，開示門戶，大義炳然，而否德闇弱，竊貪遣緒，俯仰累紀，未率大教。
units.en: I still recall how in the Huangchu era Emperor Wen of Wei sent General Xianyu Fu with a gracious, confidential message offering peace on three counts and holding the door open to us. The moral case was luminous, yet I—small in virtue and dull of wit—clung to my father's legacy, bobbing through the years without answering that higher teaching.
units.literal: Whenever I reflect on the Huangchu period, Emperor Wen ordered General Who Bares the Teeth Xianyu Fu to proclaim a warm and secret edict, extend the grace of threefold friendship, open and show the gate and door—great righteousness blazed bright—yet my deficient virtue is dim and weak; I secretly covet the thread left by those who departed; bowing and lifting my head through accumulated years, I have not followed the great instruction.

units.zh: 天威既震，人鬼歸能之數，怖駭王師，神武所次，敢不革面，順以從命！
units.en: Now that heavenly majesty has struck and every sign—human and spectral—points to submission, I tremble before your invincible host. Wherever it halts, how could I refuse to turn about and obey?
units.literal: Heaven's might having shaken, the reckoning by which men and spirits submit to capability, fearing and trembling at the royal army, wherever divine martiality halts—how dare I not change face and comply with the command!

units.zh: 輒敕群帥投戈釋甲，官府帑藏一無所毀。
units.en: I have ordered every commander to stack arms and shed armor; no government office or state store is to be touched.
units.literal: I immediately ordered the host of commanders to cast aside spears and strip armor; official bureaus and treasury stores are not to be harmed in the slightest.

units.zh: 百姓布野，餘糧棲畝，以俟後來之惠，全元元之命。
units.en: The people remain in their fields; grain still stands in the furrows, waiting for your mercy so their humble lives may be spared.
units.literal: The hundred surnames are spread across the wilds; surplus grain lodges in the fields, in order to await later kindness, and preserve the lives of the multitude.

units.zh: 伏惟大魏布德施化，宰輔伊、周，含覆藏疾。
units.en: Great Wei spreads civilizing virtue; its ministers rival the ancient worthies Yi Yin and the Duke of Zhou; its mercy covers even the flawed.
units.literal: I humbly consider that Great Wei spreads virtue and applies transformation; its ministers are like Yi and Zhou; it covers and conceals even sickness.

units.zh: 謹遣私署侍中張紹、光祿大夫譙周、駙馬都尉鄧良奉繼印綬，請命告誠，敬輸忠款，存亡敕賜，惟所裁之。
units.en: I therefore send my acting palace attendant Zhang Shao, grandee of the household Qiao Zhou, and chief groom Deng Liang with the seals of state to beg for terms and declare our good faith. Life or death rests in your judgment alone.
units.literal: I respectfully dispatch my privately appointed Palace Attendant Zhang Shao, Imperial Household Grandee Qiao Zhou, and Chief of the Capitals Grooms Deng Liang to present the seals and cords of succession, request a mandate and declare sincerity, respectfully offer loyal sincerity; as to life or death, command and grant—let it be as you decide.

units.zh: 輿櫬在近，不復縷陳。
units.en: My coffin awaits me just outside the wall; I need not belabor the point.
units.literal: The bier-cart is near at hand; I will not again enumerate in detail.

units.zh: 是日，北地王諶傷國之亡，先殺妻子，次以自殺。
units.en: That same day Liu Chen, prince of Beidi, unable to bear the fall of the kingdom, slew his wife and children and then took his own life.
units.literal: That day, the Prince of Beidi Chen, grieving the state's perishing, first killed his wife and children, next by means of this committed suicide.

units.zh: 〈《漢晉春秋》曰：後主將從譙周之策，北地王諶怒曰：「若理窮力屈，禍敗必及，便當父子君臣背城一戰，同死社稷，以見先帝可也。」
units.en: 〈The Han–Jin Annals of Spring and Autumn say that as the Later Lord prepared to adopt Qiao Zhou's counsel, Prince Liu Chen of Beidi burst out: "If argument and force are both spent and ruin is upon us, then let father and son, ruler and minister, make one last stand with our backs to the city wall and perish with the altars—that would be fit company for my father in the other world."
units.literal: 〈The Han Jin chunqiu states: When the Later Lord was about to follow Qiao Zhou's plan, the Prince of Beidi Chen angrily said: "If principle is exhausted and strength bent, disaster and defeat will surely arrive—then father and son, lord and minister ought to fight one battle with our backs to the wall, die together for the altars of soil and grain, and so meet the Former Emperor—this would be acceptable."

units.zh: 後主不納，遂送璽緩。
units.en: The Later Lord would not hear him and sent off the seals of abdication instead.
units.literal: The Later Lord did not accept; thereupon he sent the imperial seal and cords.

units.zh: 是日，諶哭於昭烈之廟，先殺妻子，而後自殺，左右無不為涕泣者。〉
units.en: He wept before Emperor Zhaolie's shrine, killed his family, and then himself; every attendant wept.〉
units.literal: That day, Chen wept at Zhaolie's temple, first killed his wife and children, and afterward committed suicide; those to his left and right none did not shed tears for him.〉

units.zh: 紹、良與艾相遇於雒縣。
units.en: Zhang Shao and Deng Liang met Deng Ai at Luo county.
units.literal: Shao and Liang met Ai at Luo county.

units.zh: 艾得書，大喜，即報書，
units.en: Deng Ai read the letter with delight and at once drafted a reply.
units.literal: When Ai obtained the letter, he was greatly pleased and immediately returned a letter,

units.zh: 〈王隱《蜀記》曰：艾報書云：「王綱失道，群英並起，龍戰虎爭，終歸真主，此蓋天命去就之道也。
units.en: 〈Wang Yin's Records of Shu preserve Deng Ai's answer: "When the imperial order falters, heroes rise like spring weeds; dragon and tiger wrestle until the true sovereign wins—that is simply heaven handing the mandate from one house to another.
units.literal: 〈Wang Yin's Shu ji states: Ai's returned letter said: "The royal net has lost the Way; many heroes arose together; dragons battled and tigers contended; in the end they return to the true lord—this is probably the Way of Heaven's mandate departing and approaching.

units.zh: 自古聖帝，爰逮漢、魏，受命而王者，莫不在乎中土。
units.en: From the sage-kings of old through Han and Wei, every house that truly received the mandate held the Central Plain.
units.literal: From ancient sage emperors down to Han and Wei, those who received the mandate and became kings have none not been centered in the Middle Land.

units.zh: 河出圖，洛出書，聖人則之，以興洪業，其不由此，未有不顛覆者也。
units.en: The Yellow River yielded its chart and the Luo its writing; the sage took them as models to build a great realm. Ignore that pattern, and ruin follows.
units.literal: The River issued the chart, the Luo issued the writing; the sage modeled them to raise a great enterprise—those who do not proceed by this have none who do not overturn.

units.zh: 隗囂憑隴而亡，公孫述據蜀而滅，此皆前世覆車之鑑也。
units.en: Wei Xiao clung to the Long passes and fell; Gongsun Shu barricaded Shu and was wiped out—history has already painted that warning in blood.
units.literal: Wei Xiao relied on the Long rampart and perished; Gongsun Shu occupied Shu and was destroyed—these are all overturned-cart mirrors of former ages.

units.zh: 聖上明哲，宰相忠賢，將比隆黃軒，侔功往代。
units.en: Our sage emperor is lucid and wise, his ministers loyal and able; their work will rival the golden age of the Yellow Emperor and match the finest dynasties of old.
units.literal: The sage ruler is enlightened and wise; the chancellor is loyal and worthy; he will compare in flourishing with the Yellow Emperor and Xuanyuan, and match achievement with past ages.

units.zh: 銜命來徵，思聞嘉響，果煩來使，告以德音，此非人事，豈天啟哉！
units.en: I came west on imperial order hoping for good news; your envoys have brought a noble message—such timing is more than human contrivance; heaven itself has opened the way!
units.literal: Bearing mandate coming to chastise, I wished to hear good tidings; truly troubling the coming envoys, they announce with virtuous sound—this is not human affair; how could it be not Heaven's opening!

units.zh: 昔微子歸周，實為上賓，君子豹變，義存大易，來辭謙衝，以禮輿櫬，皆前哲歸命之典也。
units.en: When Weizi went over to Zhou he was honored as a guest of state; the Book of Changes praises the gentleman's timely transformation. Your humble words and offer of the funeral cart match every ancient precedent for yielding to heaven.
units.literal: Formerly Weizi returned to Zhou and truly became a high guest; the nobleman's leopard change, righteousness resides in the Great Changes; coming language modest and humble, with ritual bier-cart—these are all canons of former sages submitting to the mandate.

units.zh: 全國為上，破國次之，自非通明智達，何以見王者之義乎！」
units.en: To save the whole realm is best; to shatter it is second best—without breadth of mind, who could grasp the true king's magnanimity?"
units.literal: Preserving the state is highest; destroying the state is next—if one is not penetratingly wise and clear-reaching, how can one see the kingly one's righteousness!"

units.zh: 禪又遣太常張峻、益州別駕汝超受節度，遣太僕蔣顯有命敕姜維。
units.en: Meanwhile Liu Shan sent Minister Zhang Jun and aide Ru Chao to take orders from Deng Ai, and Grand Coachman Jiang Xian with an edict for Jiang Wei to stand down.
units.literal: Shan again dispatched Minister of Ceremonies Zhang Jun and Aide-de-camp of Yizhou Ru Chao to receive regulation and control, and dispatched Grand Coachman Jiang Xian bearing orders to command Jiang Wei.

units.zh: 又遣尚書郎李虎送士民簿，領戶二十八萬，男女口九十四萬，帶甲將士十萬二千，吏四萬人，米四十餘萬斛，金銀各二千斤，錦綺採絹各二十萬匹，餘物稱此。〉
units.en: He also sent Secretariat gentleman Li Hu with the census: 280,000 households, 940,000 persons, 102,000 troops under arms, 40,000 officials, more than 4.1 million hu of grain, two thousand jin each of gold and silver, two hundred thousand bolts each of brocade and fine silks—other stores were in proportion.〉
units.literal: He also dispatched Gentleman of the Secretariat Li Hu to deliver the register of gentry and people: leading households two hundred eighty thousand, male and female mouths nine hundred forty thousand, armored generals and soldiers one hundred two thousand, clerks forty thousand, rice more than four hundred ten thousand hu, gold and silver each two thousand jin, brocade and figured silks and dyed silks each two hundred thousand bolts—remaining goods matched these.〉

units.zh: 遣紹良先還。
units.en: Zhang Shao and Deng Liang were sent back ahead of the main party.
units.literal: He dispatched Shao and Liang to return first.

units.zh: 艾至城北，後主興櫬自縛，詣軍壘門。
units.en: When Deng Ai reached the north wall of Chengdu, the Later Lord came out with a coffin on a cart, his hands bound behind him, and presented himself at the camp gate.
units.literal: When Ai arrived north of the city, the Later Lord raised a bier and bound himself and went to the camp gate of the army.

units.zh: 艾解縛焚櫬，延請相見。
units.en: Deng Ai cut his bonds, burned the bier, and received him as a guest.
units.literal: Ai loosed the bonds, burned the bier, and extended invitation to meet and see.

units.zh: 〈《晉諸公贊》曰：劉禪乘騾車詣艾，不具亡國之禮。〉
units.en: 〈The Jin Eulogies of the Dukes say Liu Shan drove a mule cart to Deng Ai and omitted the full ritual of a conquered sovereign.〉
units.literal: 〈The Jin zhugong zan states: Liu Shan rode a mule cart to visit Ai and did not perform the rites of a perished state.〉

units.zh: 因承製拜後主為驃騎將軍。
units.en: Acting on interim authority he named the Later Lord general who gallops like the piebald horse.
units.literal: Thereupon, assuming imperial writ, he appointed the Later Lord General Who Gallops Like the Piebald.

units.zh: 諸圍守悉被後主敕，然後降下。
units.en: Every ring of Shu garrisons received the Later Lord's order before laying down arms.
units.literal: The various encirclement defenders all received the Later Lord's edict, and afterward submitted and came down.

units.zh: 艾使後主止其故宮，身往造焉。
units.en: Deng Ai let him remain in his old palace and went in person to call on him.
units.literal: Ai ordered the Later Lord to stop at his former palace; he himself went to visit there.

units.zh: 資嚴未發，明年春正月，艾見收。
units.en: Before the victory bounty could be sent out, Deng Ai was arrested in the first month of the following spring.
units.literal: Funds and strictness had not yet been dispatched; in the spring, first month, of the next year, Ai was seized.

units.zh: 鍾會自涪至成都作亂。
units.en: Zhong Hui marched from Fu to Chengdu and there raised a mutiny.
units.literal: Zhong Hui from Fu arrived at Chengdu and created disorder.

units.zh: 會既死，蜀中軍眾鈔略，死喪狼籍，數日乃安集。
units.en: After Zhong Hui's death Shu became a chaos of looting and corpses in the streets; order took several days to return.
units.literal: When Hui had died, the armies and masses in Shu plundered; deaths and corpses lay strewn; only after several days were they pacified and gathered.

units.zh: 後主舉家東遷，既至洛陽，策命之曰：
units.en: The Later Lord took his household east to Luoyang, where he received this patent of appointment:
units.literal: The Later Lord moved his whole household east; when he had arrived at Luoyang, a patent of enfeoffment ordered him, saying:

units.zh: 惟景元五年三月丁亥，皇帝臨軒，使太常嘉命劉禪為安樂縣公。
units.en: On the dinghai day of the third month, 264, the Wei emperor held court and charged the minister of ceremonies to invest Liu Shan as duke of Anle county.
units.literal: On the dinghai day of the third month of the fifth year of Jingyuan, the Emperor faced the gallery and ordered the Minister of Ceremonies to grant a favorable mandate to Liu Shan as Duke of Anle county.

units.zh: 於戲，其進聽朕命！
units.en: Hearken, then, and receive Our word!
units.literal: Alas, advance and listen to Our command!

units.zh: 蓋統天載物，以咸寧為大，光宅天下，以時雍為盛。
units.en: He who spans heaven and bears the myriad creatures counts universal peace as his greatest end; he who lights the world esteems the harmony of the seasons as his highest glory.
units.literal: In general, threading Heaven and bearing the myriad things, to take universal quieting as great; broadly dwelling over all under Heaven, to take timely harmony as flourishing.

units.zh: 故孕育群生者，君人之道也，乃順承天者，坤元之義也。
units.en: To cherish and nourish all life is the way of the true king; to bow before heaven's turning is the virtue Earth itself shows in the Classic of Changes.
units.literal: Therefore to conceive and nourish the throng of the living is the Way of the lord of men; then to comply and receive Heaven is the meaning of Kun's origin.

units.zh: 上下交暢，然後萬物協和，庶類獲乿。
units.en: When high and low move in concord, the myriad things thrive and every kind of creature finds its nurture.
units.literal: Above and below exchange smoothly; thereafter the myriad things harmonize together, and the multitude of kinds obtain nurture.

units.zh: 乃者漢氏失統，六合震擾。
units.en: Long ago the Han lost the thread of rule and the realm shook with rebellion.
units.literal: Formerly the Han clan lost the thread; the six directions quaked and were disturbed.

units.zh: 我太祖承運龍興，弘濟八極，是用應天順民，撫有區夏。
units.en: Our dynastic founder caught heaven's mandate like a rising dragon, brought peace to the farthest corner, answered both heaven and the people, and took the Central States in hand.
units.literal: Our Grand Progenitor received the fortune and the dragon rose; he broadly aided the eight extremities; by this he responded to Heaven and complied with the people, soothing and possessing the regional Xia.

units.zh: 於時乃考因群傑虎爭，九服不靜，乘間阻遠，保據庸蜀，遂使西隅殊封，方外壅隔。
units.en: In those years of warlords your father seized the chance to hold the Ba–Shu fastness; the west became a separate realm and the frontier stayed closed for generations.
units.literal: At that time your deceased father, because many heroes contended like tigers, the nine domains were not quiet, exploiting the gap and blocking the distance, preserved and occupied Yong and Shu, thereupon causing the western corner to have peculiar enfeoffment and the outer regions to be blocked and cut off.

units.zh: 自是以來，干戈不戢，元元之民，不得保安其性，幾將五紀。
units.en: Ever since, arms have seldom been sheathed and the common folk have known no lasting peace—nearly sixty years.
units.literal: From this time on, shields and spears were not gathered; the black-headed people could not obtain peace and security for their natures—nearly going on five periods of twelve years.

units.zh: 朕永惟祖考遺志，思在綏緝四海，率土同軌，故爰整六師，耀威梁、益。
units.en: We have long pondered our forebears' charge to quiet the four seas and bring every road onto one track; hence We arrayed the six hosts and showed Our majesty in Liang and Yi.
units.literal: We eternally ponder Our ancestors' and fathers' bequeathed intent; Our thought is on pacifying and gathering the four seas, so that all within the soil follow the same track; therefore We thereupon arrayed the six armies and displayed might in Liang and Yi.

units.zh: 公恢崇德度，深秉大正，不憚屈身委質，以愛民全國為貴，降心回慮，應機豹變，覆信思順，以享左右無疆之休，豈不遠歟！
units.en: You, Duke, have shown high principle and true rectitude; you did not scorn to humble yourself and yield the realm to spare your people. You read the moment, changed like the leopard in the Changes, chose good faith and submission, and so win unbounded blessing on every side—could any reward be more fitting?
units.literal: The Duke broadly exalts virtue and measure, deeply grasps great correctness, does not shrink from bending body and submitting substance, taking love of the people and preserving the whole state as noble; lowering mind and turning thought, responding to the opportunity with leopard change, turning trust and pondering submission, thereby to enjoy left and right without-bound felicity—how is this not far-reaching!

units.zh: 朕嘉與君公長饗顯祿，用考咨前訓，開國胙土，率遵舊典，錫茲玄牡，苴以白茅，永為魏藩輔，往欽哉！
units.en: We delight to let you, Duke, feast on rank and stipend for years to come, take counsel from the ancient models, found your fief with clods of sacred earth, and follow every precedent of investiture: here is the black sacrificial bull, bundled in white rushes—be forever a bulwark of Wei. Go, and receive it with reverence!
units.literal: We rejoice to grant you, lord and duke, long enjoyment of illustrious emoluments; thereby to examine and consult former instruction, to open a state and enfeoff with soil, entirely following old canons; We bestow on you this black bull, wrapped with white thatch—ever be a Wei screen and support; go—revere this!

units.zh: 公其只服朕命，克廣德心，以終乃顯烈。
units.en: Honor this charge, let your virtuous intent broaden ever further, and bring your noble service to its fitting close.
units.literal: You ought respectfully to submit to Our command, being able broadly to expand the mind of virtue, thereby to complete your illustrious merit.

units.zh: 食邑萬戶，賜絹萬匹，奴婢百人，他物稱是。
units.en: His fief held ten thousand households; he received ten thousand bolts of silk, a hundred servants, and comparable gifts besides.
units.literal: A fief of ten thousand households; ten thousand bolts of silk bestowed, a hundred male and female servants, other goods in proportion.

units.zh: 子孫為三都尉封侯者五十餘人。
units.en: More than fifty of his descendants who served as commandants of the three divisions were enfeoffed as marquises.
units.literal: Descendants who served as commandants of the three divisions and were enfeoffed as marquises numbered more than fifty.

units.zh: 尚書令樊建、侍中張紹、光祿大夫譙周、秘書令卻正、殿中督張通並封列侯。
units.en: Director of the masters of writing Fan Jian, palace attendant Zhang Shao, household counsellor Qiao Zhou, director of the secretariat Xi Zheng, and palace supervisor Zhang Tong were all enfeoffed as full marquises.
units.literal: Director of the Masters of Writing Fan Jian, Palace Attendant Zhang Shao, Household Counsellor Qiao Zhou, Director of the Secretariat Xi Zheng, and Palace Supervisor Zhang Tong were all enfeoffed as full marquises.

units.zh: 《漢晉春秋》曰：司馬文王與禪宴，為之作故蜀技，旁人皆為之感愴，而禪喜笑自若。
units.en: The Han–Jin Annals of Spring and Autumn record that Sima Zhao feasted with Shan and had former Shu entertainments performed; bystanders were moved to tears, yet Shan laughed and smiled as if perfectly at ease.
units.literal: The Han–Jin Annals of Spring and Autumn state: Sima Zhao feasted with Shan and had former Shu entertainments performed for him; bystanders were all moved to sorrow, yet Shan rejoiced and laughed as if at ease.

units.zh: 王謂賈充曰：「人之無情，乃可至於是乎！
units.en: The king said to Jia Chong, "Can a man really be so devoid of feeling as this!
units.literal: The King said to Jia Chong: "That a man could be so devoid of feeling—can it really go this far!

units.zh: 雖使諸葛亮在，不能輔之久全，而況姜維邪？」
units.en: Even if Zhuge Liang were still alive, he could not have kept him safe for long—how much less Jiang Wei?"
units.literal: Even if Zhuge Liang were present, he could not have helped him endure long in safety—how much less Jiang Wei?"

units.zh: 充曰：「不如是，殿下何由並之。」
units.en: Chong replied, "If he were not so, Your Highness, how would you have conquered Shu?"
units.literal: Chong said: "If it were not so, Your Highness, by what means would you have annexed him?"

units.zh: 他日，王問禪曰：「頗思蜀否？」
units.en: Another day the king asked Shan, "Do you miss Shu at all?"
units.literal: Another day the King asked Shan: "Do you miss Shu at all?"

units.zh: 禪曰：「此間樂，不思蜀。」
units.en: Shan answered, "Life here is pleasant—I never think of Shu."
units.literal: Shan said: "Here is joy; I do not think of Shu."

units.zh: 郤正聞之，求見禪曰：「若王後問，宜泣而答曰『先人墳墓遠在隴、蜀，乃心西悲，無日不思』，因閉其目。」
units.en: Xi Zheng heard this and sought audience, advising Shan: "If the king asks again, weep and answer, 'My forebears' graves lie far off in Long and Shu; my heart grieves westward; not a day passes without longing,' and close your eyes as you speak."
units.literal: Xi Zheng heard this, sought audience with Shan, and said: "If the King later asks, you ought to weep and answer, 'My forebears' graves lie far off in Long and Shu; my heart grieves westward; not a day passes without longing,' and thereby close your eyes."

units.zh: 會王復問，對如前，王曰：「何乃似郤正語邪！」
units.en: When the king asked again, Shan answered as before. The king said, "Why does this sound like Xi Zheng's coaching!"
units.literal: When the King again asked, he answered as before; the King said: "Why does this sound like Xi Zheng's words!"

units.zh: 禪驚視曰：「誠如尊命。」
units.en: Shan looked up in alarm and said, "It is exactly as you say."
units.literal: Shan looked up in alarm and said: "It is truly as you commanded."

units.zh: 左右皆笑。
units.en: Everyone present burst out laughing.
units.literal: Those left and right all laughed.

units.zh: 公泰始七年271年薨於洛陽。
units.en: He died at Luoyang in the seventh year of the Taishi era (271).
units.literal: The Duke died at Luoyang in the seventh year of Taishi (271).

units.zh: 《蜀記》云：諡曰思公，子恂嗣。
units.en: The Records of Shu give his posthumous title as Duke Si; his son Xun succeeded him.
units.literal: The Records of Shu state: posthumous title Duke Si; his son Xun succeeded.

units.zh: 評曰：後主任賢相則為循理之君，惑閹堅則為昏暗之後，傳曰‘素絲無常，唯所染之’，信矣哉！
units.en: Chen Shou's judgment runs thus: with good chancellors at his side the Later Lord kept to the right path; once palace eunuchs swayed him he sank into folly. The adage holds: white silk shows whatever dip it meets—his reign proved it true.
units.literal: The appraisal states: The Later Lord, when he employed worthy chancellors, was a ruler who followed principle; when he was deluded by eunuch stalwarts, he was a dim successor. The tradition says, 'The plain silk has no constant hue—it takes the color of what dyes it'—truly it is so!

units.zh: 禮，國君繼體，逾年改元，而章武之三年，則革稱建興，考之古義，體理為違。
units.en: Ritual expects a new ruler to wait a full year before changing the era name, yet in the third year of Zhangwu he switched to Jianxing—set against classical usage, that was irregular.
units.literal: By ritual, when a state's lord succeeds the bodily vessel, after crossing a year he changes the reign title; yet in the third year of Zhangwu he altered it to Jianxing—examining this against ancient meaning, the substance and principle are contrary.

units.zh: 又國不置史，注記無官，是以行事多遺，災異靡書。
units.en: Nor did Shu maintain court historians or a diary office, so much of what happened went unrecorded and portents were never logged.
units.literal: Moreover the state did not establish historians; there were no offices for annotation and record—therefore in conduct of affairs much was lost, and prodigies and anomalies were not written.

units.zh: 諸葛亮雖達於為政，凡此之類，猶有未周焉。
units.en: Zhuge Liang was a master of administration, yet even he left gaps like these unfilled.
units.literal: Although Zhuge Liang was penetrating in conducting government, in categories such as these there was still incompleteness.

units.zh: 然經載十二而年名不易，軍旅屢興而赦不妄下，不亦卓乎！
units.en: For a full dozen years he left the era name untouched and refused to buy popularity with blanket pardons—few could match that discipline.
units.literal: Yet for twelve years on record the reign title was not changed; armies marched time and again yet amnesties were not issued recklessly—is this not outstanding!

units.zh: 自亮沒後，茲制漸虧，優劣著矣。
units.en: After his death the old discipline frayed, and the contrast could not have been clearer.
units.literal: From after Liang's demise, this system gradually declined—superiority and inferiority stood revealed.

units.zh: 〈《華陽國志》曰：丞相亮時，有言公惜赦者，亮答曰：“治世以大德，不以小惠，故匡衡、吳漢不原為赦。
units.en: 〈The Huayang Records relate that when someone complained Zhuge Liang granted amnesties too rarely, he answered: "Good government rests on broad moral sway, not petty indulgence—Kuang Heng and Wu Han likewise refused to make a habit of pardons.
units.literal: 〈The Huayang guo zhi states: In Chancellor Liang's time, there were those who said the duke grudged amnesties; Liang replied: "In ordering the age one relies on great virtue, not on small kindness; therefore Kuang Heng and Wu Han were unwilling to be authors of amnesties.

units.zh: 先帝亦言吾周旋陳元方、鄭康成間，每見啟告，治亂之道悉矣，曾不語赦也。
units.en: My father used to say that in his talks with Chen Ji and Zheng Xuan every question of order and chaos was covered, yet neither man ever urged him to declare an amnesty.
units.literal: The Former Emperor also said: 'In my comings and goings between Chen Yuanfang and Zheng Kangcheng, each time I saw them open and inform me, the ways of order and disorder were complete, yet they never spoke of amnesties.'

units.zh: 若劉景升、季玉父子，歲歲赦宥，何益於治！”
units.en: Look at Liu Biao and the two Liu Zhangs, who pardoned year after year—what good did it do their realm?"
units.literal: Like Liu Jingsheng and the father and son Ji Yu, year after year granting amnesty and forgiveness—what benefit was there to governance!"

units.zh: 臣松之以為‘赦不妄下’，誠為可稱，至於‘年名不易’，猶所未達。
units.en: Pei Songzhi adds that sparing amnesties deserves praise, but the praise for never changing the era name leaves him puzzled.
units.literal: Your subject Songzhi considers that 'amnesties not recklessly issued' is indeed praiseworthy; as for 'year name not changed,' I have still not comprehended.

units.zh: 案建武、建安之號，皆久而不改，未聞前史以為美談。
units.en: The Han used Jianwu and Wei used Jian'an for many years without fuss—no chronicler ever called that a special virtue.
units.literal: Examining the designations Jianwu and Jian'an, both were long without change; I have not heard former histories take this as fine discourse.

units.zh: ‘經載十二’，蓋何足云？
units.en: And what is so marvelous about a mere twelve-year span?
units.literal: 'The classics record twelve'—how is it worth speaking?

units.zh: 豈別有他意，求之未至乎！
units.en: Unless Chen Shou meant something subtler that I have failed to grasp?
units.literal: Could there be some other meaning, and in seeking it I have not reached it!

units.zh: 亮歿後，延熙之號，數盈二十，‘茲制漸虧’，事又不然也。〉
units.en: After Zhuge Liang died, the Yanxi era ran on for more than twenty years, so the claim that institutions steadily crumbled does not quite fit either.〉
units.literal: After Liang's death, the designation Yanxi, the number filled more than twenty—'this system gradually declined'—the affair is again not so.
